title: 《班后钓鱼》：下班后，去月色河岸甩一竿
title_en: After-Work Fishing: Cast a Line at the Moonlit River
description: 界维互动工作室制作的横屏夜钓模拟游戏。在月色河岸抛竿，观察鱼漂、及时扬竿，用顺滑轮盘控制收线与张力；管理跨夜鱼护，搭配钓具与稀有功法，挑战昆仑海与虚妄之海的 BOSS，把珍稀巨物收入永久收藏。
description_en: A landscape night-fishing simulator. Cast at the moonlit bank, watch the float, set the hook in time, and use a smooth reel wheel to manage line tension.

title: 《界维守卫》：在多维战场活下来
title_en: Dimension Defender: Survive the Multidimensional Battlefield
description: 界维互动工作室制作的 Android 单机弹幕生存游戏，自动射击、构筑成长、装备与 MOD 组合，带你在不断升级的怪物潮中守住维度。
description_en: An offline Android bullet-hell survivor. Auto-fire, build crafting, gear and MOD combos.

title: Cyberstorm Arena
description: 一款赛博朋克风格的大逃杀游戏，在数字竞技场中与敌人战斗，成为最后的幸存者。
description_en: A cyberpunk battle-royale. Fight enemies in a digital arena and be the last one standing.

title: Planet Drop / 星球合成
description: 轻松休闲的太空主题合成益智游戏，点击投放星球，合并相同星球创造更大的星球，最终目标是合成恒星！
description_en: A relaxing space-themed merge puzzle. Drop planets, merge identical ones to forge bigger planets.

title: 金币大亨 · 深渊觉醒
description: 一款暗黑风格的放置类点击游戏，融合了Roguelike元素和深渊探索机制。
description_en: A dark idle clicker fused with Roguelike elements and abyss exploration mechanics.

title: A Dark Room
description: 极简文字冒险挂机游戏。开局只有一團火，逐步揭开末世世界背后的真相。叙事驱动的增量游戏经典之作。
description_en: A minimalist text adventure idle game. A narrative-driven incremental classic.

title: Antimatter Dimensions
description: 社区公认的深度增量游戏天花板。无尽 prestige 层级，从反物质到永恒到现实，数字规模的哲学之旅。已集成简体中文汉化。
description_en: The community-crowned ceiling of deep incremental games. Endless prestige layers.

title: Candy Box 2
description: 表面是 ASCII 糖果点击器，底下藏着 RPG、迷宫、法術、Boss战。探索感极强，内容量惊人。
description_en: An ASCII candy clicker hiding RPG, mazes, spells and boss fights underneath.

title: Cookie Clicker
description: 经典到不能再经典的点击放置游戏。烤饼干、买升级、解锁成就、探索隐藏内容。支持简体中文。
description_en: The quintessential clicker idle game. Bake cookies, buy upgrades, unlock achievements.

title: 猫国建设者 / Kittens Game
description: `猫国建设者 (Kittens Game)` 是一款由 bloodrizer 开发的黑暗灵魂放置类增量游戏。
description_en: A dark-souls-tier idle incremental developed by bloodrizer.

title: Synergism
description: 继 Antimatter Dimensions 之后的又一深度增量巨作。5 层 prestige 系统、协同效应机制、海量内容。支持简体中文。
description_en: A deep incremental epic. Five prestige layers, synergy mechanics, massive content.

title: Trimps 脆皮
description: Trimps 是一款深度极高的放置类增量游戏。管理你的 Trimp 军队，探索地图，解锁科技，不断转生突破。汉化版基于 v4.5。
description_en: A deeply layered idle incremental. Manage your Trimp army, explore, unlock tech, reincarnate.

title: 末世重生：囤货女王
description: 一款末世题材的互动叙事游戏，你将扮演重生者，在末日降临前囤积物资、建立关系、改变命运。
description_en: An apocalyptic interactive narrative. Reborn before the end, hoard supplies, change fate.

title: A Dark Forest / 黑暗森林
description: `A Dark Forest` is an open-source incremental game by Maksim Chmutov / TinyTakinTeller and contributors. This page embeds the published HTML5 runtime directly, instead of the itch.io project page, bec
description_en: An open-source incremental game. Embeds the published HTML5 runtime directly.

title: Classic Snake
description: Classic Snake, kept intentionally small: one grid, one food item, score tracking, game-over on wall or self collision, and instant restart.
